recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, warm-toned close-up portrait of a man with blonde hair and round wire-rimmed glasses, looking slightly upward and off-camera. The background is a soft, out-of-focus earthy brown, and the typography is placed at the extreme top edges in a clean, sans-serif italic style.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed toward the upper right corner
Typography anchored to the top left and top right margins
Warm skin tones harmonizing with the blurred brown background
Reflections in the circular lenses adding depth to the facial focal point
coreInvariants: Shallow depth of field with a textured, dark background
Italicized sans-serif typography at the top edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale headshot occupying 80% of the frame, slightly off-center to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular lenses of the glasses and the subject's eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, follows the gaze upward, then moves to the text elements at the top corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, concentrated in the upper right and lower left corners with a soft-focus texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earthy browns and ochres in the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and blonde highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White typography and white collar highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-to-medium saturation with a high emphasis on warm mid-tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both name and title to maintain minimalist balance.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, mid-century modern aesthetic and uniform stroke.
Provides the necessary geometric clarity and professional spacing.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man with 1970s-style blonde hair and round wire glasses, looking up. Use warm lighting and a blurred dark brown background. Leave clear space at the very top edge for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place uppercase sans-serif italic text in white at the top left and top right corners, aligned with the outer margins.

verificationChecks: Is the text strictly in the top corners?
Is the lighting warm and golden-hour adjacent?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the warm color cast
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Any record label logos or catalog numbers
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gaze direction feels aspirational
Verify typography is legible against the background
Confirm the absence of modern digital artifacts
recipe.reuseFormula: Warm Portrait + Round Glasses + Top-Corner Italic Sans-Serif
